entities.summary: Anandshankar Bapubhai Dhruv was a Gujarati scholar, writer, educationist and editor from Bombay Presidency, British India. His name is revered as "Acharya" in Gujarat, and hence generally he is known as Acharya Anandshankar Dhruv.
